answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use decaying reputation renewed only by genuine mentorship. Standing fades each season unless its owner publicly teaches a newcomer a skill and that learner independently passes a fresh, checkable test. Like a grove that survives only if gardeners keep tending new growth, standing must be re-earned, not bought once. One operator running many fakes faces a hard inlet problem: each fake needs its own pupil, and pupils cannot be scripted clones. A public atlas records who taught whom, so self-teaching clusters stand out and can be pruned before they vote.
